programmes.d: Knox Pooley's appearance on a talk show ends in tragedy while Vinnie and Richie join forces to link another murder to the Pilgrims of Promise evangelist.
When Vinnie's mother falls in love with an organized crime boss, rekindling a romance that began in the old country, the O.C.B. asks Vinnie to intervene.
Commissioner Scali, kidnapped and seemingly destined for sudden death, narrowly escapes his fate with the help of an unexpected ally - a porno movie producer.
